Package IoTFleetManagement.agent.service

Klasse AgentService

java.lang.Object
IoTFleetManagement.agent.service.AgentService
@Service public class AgentService extends Object
Service class for managing IoT Agents in the fleet management system.

This class provides the business logic for managing agents, including adding new agents, retrieving agent information, checking agent status, updating status, and assigning agents to users.

Autor:
Lara, Jasmin1707, Miriam

      public boolean getAgentStatus(String agentId) throws org.springframework.data.crossstore.ChangeSetPersister.NotFoundException
      Retrieves the online status of a specific agent.
      Parameter:
      agentId - the unique identifier of the agent
      Gibt zurück:
      true if the agent is online, false otherwise
      Löst aus:
      org.springframework.data.crossstore.ChangeSetPersister.NotFoundException - if the agent is not found

    • addAgent

      public Agent addAgent(Agent agent)
      Adds a new agent to the system.

      This method validates the input, hashes the secret key, generates a JWT token, and saves the agent to the database.

      Parameter:
      agent - the agent to be added
      Gibt zurück:
      the saved agent with its assigned ID and token
      Löst aus:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the agent ID is null or blank
      AlreadyExistsException - if an agent with the same agent ID already exists

    • updateAgentStatus

      public void updateAgentStatus(String agentId, boolean isOnline) throws org.springframework.data.crossstore.ChangeSetPersister.NotFoundException
      Updates the online status of a specific agent.

      The method also updates the `lastSeen` timestamp with the current time.

      Parameter:
      agentId - the unique identifier of the agent
      isOnline - the new online status of the agent
      Löst aus:
      org.springframework.data.crossstore.ChangeSetPersister.NotFoundException - if the agent is not found

    • registerAgentToUser

      public Agent registerAgentToUser(String secretKey, User user)
      Registers an agent to a user based on a secret key.

      This method verifies the secret key, ensures the agent is not already registered to another user, and assigns the agent to the specified user.

      Parameter:
      secretKey - the secret key of the agent
      user - the user to assign the agent to
      Gibt zurück:
      the updated agent with the assigned user
      Löst aus:
      RuntimeException - if the secret key is invalid or the agent is already registered to another user

    • assignFirmwareToAgent

      public Agent assignFirmwareToAgent(Long agentId, Long firmwareId)
      Assigns a firmware version to an agent by updating the agent's firmware version.

      This method retrieves an agent and a firmware version by their respective IDs. If both exist, it assigns the specified firmware version to the agent and saves the updated agent back to the database.

      Parameter:
      agentId - the unique identifier of the agent to which the firmware version will be assigned
      firmwareId - the unique identifier of the firmware version to assign to the agent
      Gibt zurück:
      the updated Agent entity after the firmware assignment
